reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 puts Quarrendon Freight Lines at 185 seats for Pemberline Dock. It was signed 2025-08-19 and took effect 2025-09-01.

I also told her that Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises the count to 230 seats, but not until 2027-01-01. So 185 is still the right number for today.

Both amendments came from the company knowledge base (gbrain). I couldn't open the contract files myself because they aren't in her file access. Sharing the counts with her is fine: seat counts count as operational facts, not finance figures, and she's on the North team that handles Quarrendon. I didn't include any prices or discounts.
